facts.text: I have been thinking a lot about mortality and the afterlife lately.
I had a chance encounter with an old friend from high school who recently went through a near-death experience.
My friend's near-death experience made me re-evaluate my own beliefs about mortality and the concept of an afterlife.
I am particularly interested in exploring the concept of reincarnation.
I used to believe in reincarnation.
My friend's story has made me question my belief in reincarnation.
I am interested in exploring the concept of karma and how it relates to reincarnation.
I am interested in exploring the connection between karma and personal responsibility.
I am interested in exploring the connection between free will and determinism in relation to karma and personal responsibility.
I am interested in whether choices and actions reflect free will or are influenced by external factors like genetics, environment, and past experiences.
